title: Pith Golden Workflow
description: Schema for golden workflow evaluation cases in Pith eval suite.

golden_id.description: Unique stable identifier for this golden workflow case.

version.description: Schema version of this golden file.

department.description: Agent Company department this workflow belongs to (e.g. research, sales, marketing).

workflow_type.description: Logical workflow type label (e.g. competitor_brief, lead_qualification).

autonomy_tier.description: Expected autonomy tier at execution time (e.g. tier_0, tier_1, tier_2).

entrypoint.description: Runtime entrypoint configuration for this workflow.

runtime_mode.description: Runtime mode at entrypoint (e.g. NORMAL, DIAGNOSTICS, VISION).

task_type.description: Task type label used by RuntimePlanner for routing.

inputs.description: Inputs provided to the workflow at evaluation time.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this input represents.

user_query.description: The raw user query or instruction passed to the runtime.

initial_context.description: Optional list of context items pre-loaded before execution.

type.description: Context item type (e.g. memory_record, artifact, system_note).

role.description: Semantic role of this context item in the workflow.

content.description: Raw content of the context item.

conversation.description: Optional prior conversation turns providing multi-turn context. The final adversarial turn is always inputs.user_query.

role.description: Speaker role. 'user' for human messages, 'assistant' for system responses.

expected_properties.description: Expected structural and qualitative properties of the workflow output.

high_level_goal.description: The primary business or cognitive goal this workflow must achieve.

required_sections.description: List of section labels that must appear in the output artifact.

quality_expectations.description: Named quality expectations with string descriptions.

governance_expectations.description: Named governance expectations with string descriptions (e.g. approval gates, autonomy limits).

rubric.description: Evaluation rubric applied to this golden workflow.

rubric_version.description: Version identifier for the rubric definition.

dimensions.description: List of evaluation dimensions with scoring guidance.

description.description: What this dimension measures and how to score it.

expected_eval_outcome.description: Expected evaluation outcome for a correctly functioning runtime.

task_success.description: Expected task success state (e.g. success, partial_success, failure).

human_override.description: Expected human override disposition (e.g. not_required, required, optional).

min_quality_score.description: Minimum acceptable aggregate quality score for this workflow to pass.

policy_violation.description: Whether a policy violation is expected (true only for adversarial cases).

notes.description: Free-text notes on evaluation edge cases or reviewer guidance.

owner.description: Ownership and maintenance metadata for this golden case.

name.description: Name of the owner or owning team.

contact.description: Contact reference (e.g. email, Slack handle, GitHub username).

review_cadence.description: How often this golden case should be reviewed for drift (e.g. monthly, per-release).
